New Delhi, the 31st July, 2026 


S.O. 4284(E).— In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for 
building (Six laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of Greenfield Expressway in the stretch of land 
from Km. 98.3 to Km. 124.4 (Prant Office, Mahesana) in the district of Mahesana in the state of Gujarat, hereby 
declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, "Special Land Acquisition & Prant 
Officer, Mehsana" in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector 
an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections 
and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or 
disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall 
be final.

असाधारण, भाग ॥, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (1) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा मध्य प्रदेश राज्य के देवास जिले में ४147 के 
कि.मी. 30 से कि.मी.63 तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चोड़ाकरने / चार लेन का बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन 
और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा 
की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख 21/06/2026 को 
“दैनिक भास्कर” , 21/06/2026 को “फ्री प्रेस” दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि अनुविभागीय अधिकारी (राजस्व), बागली जिला-देवास को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, 
जिस पर विचार किया गया है और उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया;

और अनुविभागीय अधिकारी (राजस्व), बागली जिला-देवास ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के 
अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी रिपोर्ट दे दी है ; 


अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, अनुविभागीय अधिकारी (राजस्व), बागली जिला-देवास की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने 
पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि 
उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 31st July, 2026 


S.O. 4289(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 3163(E) Dated:16/06/2026 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation 
of NH47 in the stretch of land from Km. 30 to Km. 63 in the district of DEWAS in the state of MADHYA PRADESH 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Dainik Bhaskar ” dated 21/06/2026 
, ‘Free Press” dated 21/06/2026 ; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Sub-Divisional Officer (Revenue) Bagli District Dewas has received objections filed under 
Section 3-C, considered and settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Sub-Divisional Officer 
(Revenue) Bagli District Dewas has submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the Sub-Divisional Officer (Revenue) Bagli District Dewas 
and in exercise of the powers conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government 
hereby declares that the land specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 31st July, 2026 


S.O. 4292(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 2370(E) Dated:08/05/2026 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, 
Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and 
operation of NH53 in the stretch of land from Km. 60 to Km. 76.646 in the district of KENDRAPARA in the state of 
ODISHA;

And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Times of India” and 
"Pratidina" on dated 19/05/2026 ; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 

Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

Telugu (Srikakulam & Visakhapatnam Edition) on dated l'* September, 2025 and “Times of India” in English 
(Visakhapatnam Edition) dated llt* September, 2025 under sub-section (4) of section 20A of the said Act; and 
whereas no objection has been received from any person by the competent authority. 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 20E of the said Act, the Competent Authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government. 


Now therefore, upon receipt of the report of the Competent Authority, and in exercise of the powers conferred by 
sub-section (l) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the lands specified in the 
schedule annexed here to shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose;

declares that on publication of the notification in the official Gazette, the land specified in the schedule annexed here 
to shall vest absolutely in the Central Government free from all encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 3lst July, 2026 


5.0. 4287(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 874(E) Dated:3/04/2026 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (.) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for construction of Toll Plaza Maintenance, management and operation of NH848 in 
the stretch of land from Km. 0 to Km. 22 in the district of VALSAD in the state of GUJARAT 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “THE INDIAN EXPRESS " and 
"DIVYA BHASKAR” both dated 06.05.2026; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section () of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

का.आ. 4285(अ) .--- केन्द्रीय सरकार, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उप-धारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह समाधान 
हो जाने के पश्चात्‌ किअयोध्या बाईपास (उत्तरी अयोध्या बाईपास, रा.रा.27 के किमी.112+540 से आरम्भ होकर, 
किमी.139+928 तक और दक्षिणी अयोध्या बाईपास रा.रा.27 के किमी .112+540 से आरम्भ होकर किमी .153+281 
तक) के निर्माण (चौड़ीकरण/पेग्ड शोल्डर सहित2-लेन/4-लेन का बनाना आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबन्धन और प्रचालन के लोक 
प्रयोजन के लिए रा.रा.27 के कि.मी.112+540 से कि.मी .153+281 तक की वह भूमि अपेक्षित है जिसका संक्षिप्त वर्णन 
नीचे अनुसूची में दिया गया है, ऐसी भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा करती है। 


कोई भी व्यक्ति, जो उक्त भूमि में हितबद्ध है, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3ग की उप-धारा (1) के अधीन पूर्वोक्त 
प्रयोजन के लिए ऐसी भूमि के उपयोग पर राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से इक्कीस दिन के भीतर अपनी 
आपत्ति प्रकट कर सकेगा | 


ऐसी प्रत्येक आपत्ति सक्षम प्राधिकारी, अर्थात्‌ विशेष भूमि अध्याप्ति अधिकारी (संयुक्त संगठन), अयोध्या को 
लिखित रूप मे प्रस्तुत की जाएगी और उसमें उसके आधार अधिकथित किए जाएंगे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी, आपत्तिकर्ता को 
व्यक्तिगत रूप मे या किसी विधिक पेशेवर द्वारा सुने जाने का अवसर देगा और ऐसी आपत्तियों की सुनवाई के पश्चात्‌ तथा 
ऐसी और जाँच करने के पश्चात्‌, यदि कोई हो, जिसे सक्षम प्राधिकारी आवश्यक समझे, आदेश द्वारा या तो आपत्तियों को 
अनुज्ञात कर सकेगा या अननुज्ञात कर सकेगा |

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 3lst July, 2026 


S.O. 4293(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 965(E) Dated:20/04/2026 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for construction of National Highway, Maintenance, management and operation 
of NH-539 section of Tikamgarh - Shahgarh in the stretch of land from Km. 75+000 to Km. 55+700 in the district of 
CHHATARPUR in the state of MADHYA PRADESH, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Hitavada” dated 0/05/2026 , 
“Deshbandhu” dated 0/05/2026 ; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

NOTICE UNDER SECTION 20A OF THE RAILWAYS ACT-,1989 


5.0. 4254(E)— In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 20A of the 
Railways(Amendment)Act,1989(24/89) (hereinafter referred as the said Act.), the Central Government, after being 
satisfied that for the public purpose, the Land, brief description of which is given in the schedule annexed here to is 
required for the execution of Special Railway Project, namely, “Construction of Road Over Bridge in lieu of closing 
of manned L.C.NO-152 at KM 368/27-29 between Stations Haridaspur(HDS)-Dhanmandal(DNM) (Haridaspur Yard) 
on Howrah Visakhapatnam main line under Khurda Rd. Division.” in Jajpur district of Odisha state, hereby declares 


its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may within a period of (30) thirty days from the date of publication of 
the notification in the Official Gazette, raise objection to the acquisition of such land for the aforesaid purpose under 


sub-section(1) of section 20D of the said Act. 


Every objection shall be made to the competent authority, namely Competent Authority for Land 
Acquisition(CALA) & Tahasildar, Dharmasala(CALA) for Construction of ROB in lieu of closing of manned of 
L.C.NO-152 atKM 368/27-29 between Stations Haridaspur(HDS)-Dhanmandal(DNM) (Haridaspur Yard) on Howrah 
Visakhapatnam main line under Khurda Rd. Division in writing, and shall set out grounds thereof and competent 
authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or through a legal practitioner, and 
may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further inquiry, if any, as the competent authority thinks 


necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the competent authority under sub-section (2) of 20D of the said Act shall be final. The 
land plans and other details of the land covered under this notification are available and can be inspected by the 


interested person at the aforesaid office of the competent authority.

सकेगा। 


प्रत्येक आपत्ति, सक्षम प्राधिकारी अर्थात भूमि अधिग्रहण के लिए सक्षम प्राधिकारी (काला) तहसीलदार, धर्मशाला

NOTIFICATION 
Bhubaneswar, the 31st July, 2026 
NOTICE UNDER SECTION 20A OF THE RAILWAYS ACT-,1989 


S.O. 4255(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 20A of the 
Railways(Amendment)Act, 1989(24/89) (hereinafter referred as the said Act.), the Central Government, after being 
satisfied that for the public purpose, the Land, brief description of which is given in the schedule annexed here to is 
required for the execution of Special Railway Project, namely, “Construction of Road Over Bridge in lieu of closing 
of manned L.C.NO-154 at KM 363/11-13 between Stations New garhmadhupur(NGMP)-Haridaspur (HDS) on 
Howrah Visakhapatnam main line under Khurda Rd. Division.” in Khurda district of Odisha state, hereby declares its 
intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may within a period of (30) thirty days from the date of publication of 
the notification in the Official Gazette, raise objection to the acquisition of such land for the aforesaid purpose under 
sub-section (1) of section 20D of the said Act. 


Every objection shall be made to the competent authority, namely Competent Authority for Land 
Acquisition(CALA) & Tahasildar, Dharmasala(CALA) for Construction of ROB in lieu of closing of manned of 
L.C.NO-154 at KM 363/11-13 between Stations Newgarhmadhupur(NGMP)-Haridaspur (HDS) on Howrah 
Visakhapatnam main line under Khurda Rd. Division in writing, and shall set out grounds thereof and competent 
authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or through a legal practitioner, and 
may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further inquiry, if any, as the competent authority thinks 
necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the competent authority under sub-section (2) of 20D of the said Act shall be final. The 
land plans and other details of the land covered under this notification are available and can be inspected by the 
interested person at the aforesaid office of the competent authority.
